_comment: Configurable display copy for Just a Little Fun — BLACKJACK. Edit freely. Tokens in {curly braces} are filled in at runtime (available tokens are noted per section). The HOST reads this from ./data/phrases.json; the PLAYER page reads the same file. The host merge is SHALLOW — if you include an object like 'champion', include ALL of its fields, since the whole object replaces the built-in default. Any field whose value is an ARRAY is a pool of interchangeable variants: the code picks one at random each time, so repeated events feel fresh. Single-string fields are used verbatim.
finaleTicker: That's the table — final results are up
Cards down — the table is settled
Last hand's dealt — here's how it landed
Shoe's empty — final standings are in

champion._tokens: {amount} = dollar figure, no sign (the phrase supplies its own $ and arrow). subMany shows when more than one player finished; subSolo when only one. Each field is an array of variants chosen at random.
subMany: The sharpest read at the table
profitDown: ▼ Lost ${amount} and still won the room
profitFlat: Square on the night — and still on top
Broke even and took the crown
Not a dollar moved — still the best
Level pegging, top of the pile

placement._comment: Player-side end-of-game placement copy. rank 1/2/3 and last are special; middle of the table scales by band (top/mid/back). 'medal' is a single emoji; 'headline' and the 'sub' fields are arrays of variants chosen at random. For 'first', subMany shows with 2+ players and subSolo with one.

headline: Champion!
You took the room!
Top of the table!
Winner, winner!
subMany: You topped the table and took the whole room. Drinks are on you.
Nobody played it better. The room is yours.
Sharpest read on the night — you cleaned up.
Sitting pretty at the top of the felt. Take a bow.
subSolo: Last one standing — the title is yours.
You outlasted every other player. Champion by attrition.
The lone survivor takes the crown.
Everyone else busted out. You didn't.

headline: So, so close
A whisker short
Runner-up
Second by a hair
sub: A hair off the top spot — unlucky.
So near the crown you could taste it. Next hand's yours.
Beaten by a whisker — hold your head high.
Second best in the room. Cruel margins.

headline: On the podium
Bronze and proud
Third and thereabouts
In the money
sub: A spot on the podium and bragging rights to match. Solid session.
You made the top three — no small feat in this room.
Third place and plenty to be pleased about.
On the board and in the money. Nicely done.

headline: Wooden spoon
Someone had to
The cellar's yours
Down the very back
sub: Someone had to prop up the table — might as well wear it with pride. There's always next time.
Rock bottom, but you were in it till the last card. Chin up.
The wooden spoon is a badge of sorts. Wear it well.
Last of the pack — nowhere to go but up next time.

headline: Top of the pack
Just off the medals
Best of the rest
Knocking on the podium
sub: Just missed the medals but well clear of the pack. Nicely played.
A place or two off the podium — a strong session all the same.
Best of the rest tonight. The top three was in sight.
So close to a medal. Well clear of the muddle.

headline: Mid-table finish
Right in the mix
Smack in the middle
Held your own
sub: Right in the thick of it — a few hands away from the top end. Respectable night.
Squarely mid-table. A tidy result with room to climb.
In the thick of the pack all night. Solid enough.
Middle of the road — a few good calls from the sharp end.

headline: Down the table
Near the back
Dodged the spoon
A tough session
sub: Hung in there near the back, but you dodged the wooden spoon. We'll call that a win.
Back of the pack, but not the very bottom. Small mercies.
A rough night at the felt — but you avoided the spoon.
Near the rear, still swinging. Next session's a fresh start.
